name: unslop-backend
description: Stop vibecoded backends from shipping 200-query N+1 loops and full table scans. An agent skill that profiles, fixes, and proves SQL, ORM, and API speedups with paired benchmarks and SHA-256 parity.

scripts.validate:sample: node skills/unslop-backend/validate-workload-ledger.cjs --repo-root examples/sloppy-saas-api --require-complete examples/sample-audit-output/workload-ledger.json && node skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs examples/sample-audit-output/baseline.json examples/sample-audit-output/after.json && node skills/unslop-backend/validate-findings.cjs --repo-root examples/sloppy-saas-api --ledger examples/sample-audit-output/workload-ledger.json --baseline examples/sample-audit-output/baseline.json --after examples/sample-audit-output/after.json examples/sample-audit-output/findings.json && node skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/baseline.json examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/after.json
scripts.test: npm run test:validators && npm run test:benchmarks && npm run validate:sample && npm run check:repo
